```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
glimpse(penguins)
summary(penguins$bill_length_mm)
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(avg_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm,na.rm=TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = avg_bill_length, fill = species)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Bill Length by Penguin Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Average Bill Length (mm)"
  )
```
